newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary's Chinoin plans HUF18,500 dividend on 1996.
newsitem.headline: Hungary's Chinoin plans HUF18,500 dividend on 1996.

text.p: Hungarian pharmaceuticals firm Chinoin Gyogyszer- es Vegyeszeti Termekek Gyara Rt said on Wednesday it planned to pay a 18,500 forints per share dividend on 1996 earnings, up from 5,000 forints in 1995.
Chinoin's annual shareholders' meeting is set for May 24, it said in a statement.
At an extraordinary shareholders meeting in December 1996 Chinoin's shareholders approved the payout of a dividend advance of 13,500 forints per share.
Bids and offers on the over-the-counter market for Chinoin shares -- which have a face value of 10,000 forints -- range between 61,000 and 120,000 forints, according to daily newspaper information.
Chinoin is majority owned by France's Sanofi Pharma S.A, which is the wholly owned unit of Sanofi, a member of the Elf Aquitaine group.
